title: Ordinary finite-type conormal cohomology is ideal-power torsion on an etale complement
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $H\subseteq A$ an ideal, and $C$ a finite type commutative $A$-algebra such that $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale over $\operatorname{Spec}A\setminus V(H)$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra, def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Choose any surjective $A$-algebra map $\alpha:A[y_1,\ldots,y_s]\to C$ with $s\geq0$ finite and kernel $K$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Put $d_\alpha:K/K^2\to C^{\oplus s}$, $f\bmod K^2\mapsto(\alpha(\partial f/\partial y_j))_j$. Its kernel $M_1$ and cokernel $M_0$ are finitely generated $C$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. There exists $b\geq0$ such that $H^bM_1=H^bM_0=0$, where every element of $H^b$ acts through $A\to C$.
